description: Replace the list of the agent's tools whose output the customer's app shows as a component (a chart, a card): their output is then not checked as an answer. Give the whole list; names are kept as given, duplicates dropped. Read the current list and the tools seen in traces with get_ui_tools first.

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

tools.description: Every tool name to show as UI, exactly as the agent calls it. Replaces the saved list; an empty list clears it.
tools.title: Tools

name: set_ui_tools
